{{Quote|Tell you where I saw it? Not for all the t'bac on Annaj, mah bukee. You want the Tessent, you're on your own.|Testimony of Barzur Antilles|<ref name="Tessent">{{GamerCite|9|Race for the Tessent}}</ref>}}
'''Barzur Antilles''' lived at some point by [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. They once gave a testimony at the [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell sector's]] [[Annaj House of Detention]] in which they claimed to have seen one of the [[Alsakan Tessent|two]] [[Ayrou Tessent|artifacts]] known as the [[Tessent]]s. However, Antilles refused to reveal the location where they had seen the highly sought-after item.

==Biography==
{{Quote|That's kind of funny&mdash;you'd think two planets could find a decent artist between 'em so there wouldn't be this wild gundark chase.|Testimony of Barzur Antilles|<ref name="Tessent">{{GamerCite|9|Race for the Tessent}}</ref>}}
[[File:Planet15-SWR.png|thumb|right|300px|Barzur Antilles once gave a testimony at the House of Detention of the planet Annaj.]]
Barzur Antilles was an individual who lived at some point by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. They once gave a testimony at the [[Annaj House of Detention|House of Detention]] of<ref name="Tessent" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Annaj/Legends|Annaj]], [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell sector]].<ref name="Endor">{{GamerCite|9|Endor and the Moddell Sector}}</ref>

In the testimony, Antilles claimed to have seen one of the two artifacts known as the [[Tessent]]s and provided a brief description of the item. According to Antilles' claims, they were never certain of whether the Tessent they had observed had been the [[Alsakan Tessent|one]] originating on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] planet [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]] or the [[Ayrou Tessent|one]] created by the [[Ayrou/Legends|Ayrou]] [[Species/Legends|species]]&mdash;whom Antilles referred to as "feather-heads"&mdash;of the Moddell [[Sector/Legends|sector]] world [[Maya Kovel/Legends|Maya Kovel]]. Antilles did not, however, believe that it resembled the traditional Alsakani description of their world's Tessent as a sculpture of a [[farlus hawk]] with the head of a [[Felinx/Legends|felinx]]. Furthermore, the individual did not appreciate the craftsmanship of the idol they had seen, implying that it indicated the lack of a "decent [[Artist/Legends|artist]]" between Alsakan and Maya Kovel&mdash;a situation that Antilles found amusing and believed contributed to the complicated nature of the ongoing [[Treasure hunting/Legends|search]] for the Tessents.<ref name="Tessent" />

{{RPG|"[[Race for the Tessent]]"}}
When Antilles was then asked by an individual whom they addressed as "mah bukee" to divulge the location where they had seen the Tessent, the giver of the testimony adamantly refused, claiming they would not trade that information for "all the [[t'bac]] on Annaj." Antilles subsequently [[Death/Legends|died]]<ref name="Tessent" /> at some point by [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="3 ABY" /> before the Alsakan and Ayrou Tessents were discovered on the planets [[Ast Kikorie/Legends|Ast Kikorie]] and [[Vasha/Legends|Vasha]], respectively.<ref name="Tessent" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Barzur Antilles was introduced in the [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure "[[Race for the Tessent]]," which was published for use with [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' in the [[Star Wars Gamer 9|ninth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Gamer]]'' magazine<ref name="Tessent" /> on [[February 22]], [[2002]].<ref name="GamerDate">{{SWArchive|url=gaming/other/rpg/news20020222.html|text=Starfighters Soar in Gamer #9}}</ref> Instead of featuring a set plot, "Race for the Tessent" presents several settings in the Moddell [[Sector/Legends|sector]] that the player characters may visit during their search for one of the Tessent artifacts. For each of the settings, the adventure also suggests possible circumstances for a Tessent being hidden there. Assuming that as much of the non-contradictory information presented in the adventure as possible is [[canon]]ical with respect to the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, this article assumes that the Alsakan Tessent and the Ayrou Tessent were hidden on Ast Kikorie and Vasha, respectively.<ref name="Tessent" />
